content.short: Tableland is an open source, permissionless cloud database built on SQLite.
content.description: Tableland is a web3 SQL database designed for use on EVM-compatible chains, including Ethereum and Layer 2 networks. It expands and enhances data storage by delegating data accessibility to a decentralized validator network that observes the host chain for updates, making SQL data available to applications. Developers can leverage Tableland to scale, mutate, and retrieve chain-driven data—covering on-chain rules and identity—across Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum One, Arbitrum Nova, Polygon, and Filecoin.
